card.text: M22 is a globular star cluster in the Milky Way, about 3,300 parsecs away.

sources.label: Baumgardt & Vasiliev (2021), Accurate distances to Galactic globular clusters through a combination of Gaia EDR3, HST and literature data, MNRAS 505, 5957; Baumgardt's orbits table, NGC_6656: Rsun 3.3 ± 0.04 kpc
Wikipedia, "Messier 22"
sources.quote: Messier 22 or M22, also known as NGC 6656 or the Great Sagittarius Cluster, is an elliptical globular cluster of stars in the constellation Sagittarius, near the Galactic bulge region.

introduction.text: M22 is drawn as 2,398 of its member stars, measured by Gaia; each dot sits at its sky position, at the cluster's distance.
